narrationManifestRole: Inherited transcript and caption clock; current soundtrack is supplied complete, not synthesized or remixed.
transitionPolicy: Preserve the complete supplied soundtrack and original montage without remixing or retiming.

inheritedV12Quality.sourcePolicy: Unchanged checked V9 encoded pictures are retained where possible. Changed joins and the credited added archive photographs/films/official visualizations are encoded at 1080p50 without generated detail. Narration is rebuilt per scene, authentic historical speech is retained from checked source audio, and the licensed score is remixed with long crossfades. Original production inputs remain outside the repository in a local application cache.
inheritedV12Quality.runtimeFallback: HLS-only HD delivery; full-resolution review MP4s remain local because they exceed the static host per-file limit.

deliveryValidation.method: Complete checked video decode and delivered HLS AAC waveform checks. Audio encoder priming packet removed before fMP4 packaging.

inheritedV12Quality.originalMasterPolicy: Rebuilt from retained original source clips, never enlarged from the low-bitrate fallback. Native1080/4K sources and60fps originals are used where retained and traceable; lower-resolution archival footage is upscaled with Lanczos; source frame rates are resampled by selecting/repeating frames. No optical-flow-generated frames or invented archival detail.
